title: Key with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Key shaft -->
  <rect x='38' y='52' width='14' height='38' rx='5' fill='#F2C94C'/>
  <!-- Shaft highlight -->
  <rect x='41' y='55' width='4' height='30' rx='2' fill='#F8E08E'/>
  <!-- Key bow (ring) -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='22' fill='#E8A020'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='14' fill='#F2C94C'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#F8E08E' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- Key teeth -->
  <rect x='50' y='68' width='14' height='8' rx='3' fill='#E8A020'/>
  <rect x='50' y='80' width='10' height='8' rx='3' fill='#E8A020'/>
  <!-- Teeth highlights -->
  <rect x='53' y='70' width='8' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#F8E08E'/>
  <rect x='53' y='82' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#F8E08E'/>
  <!-- Face on key bow -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='33' r='4' fill='#4A2C0A'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='33' r='4' fill='#4A2C0A'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='31.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='53.5' cy='31.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M36 43 Q45 53 54 43' stroke='#4A2C0A' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='41' r='3.5' fill='#F28B6B' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='3.5' fill='#F28B6B' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
